reader: fresh-context Claude subagent (same model family as the author; partial independence only, PE-CLS-1.0 s10.6). Instructed to read only the three files below and nothing else, no web.

reader_inputs.spec_snapshot: spec/PE-CLS-1.0.md and spec/PE-DSC-1.0.md at commit ce252fa (before P6 and before the A1/A4 amendments)
reader_inputs.entries: the 24 external entries with spec_gate and checkable removed (id, title, source, defect, detected_by only)

DB-X01.why: s7.5 A2 requires each fitted object's fit data and its overlap with evaluation data; A3 construction check asks whether the estimand comes from the selecting fit alone.

DB-X02.why: s7.5 A2: selection fit on the same data as evaluation shows up as fit/evaluation overlap; A3 construction check is secondary.

DB-X03.why: No normative multiplicity check. s3.2/s7.5.1 sizing only needs to be stated (or declared not done); s10.5 registration theater is informative.

DB-X04.why: Neither spec requires validating the inference method's false-positive rate on null data; hashing and re-running an instrument would reproduce the bug.

DB-X05.why: s7.5 A2: fitted objects must be identified on data fit for their role, with overlap declared; leakage types such as unavailable features need a coder's call.

DB-X06.why: s7.5 A4: fixed estimand and denominator, a per-arm exclusion account, one registered scoring convention; selective exclusion and odd weighting break these.

DB-X07.why: s7.5 A4 'one registered scoring convention' refuses picking the LR p over the Pearson p; s3.2/P1 requires the stopping rule to be registered before measurement.

DB-X08.why: s7.1 P1 ancestry: the DVs, stopping rule and design (s3.2) are fixed before the result commit; A4 single registered estimand is secondary.

DB-X09.why: No listed check catches row offsets or sample mislabels; s4.2 withdrawn class only records the defect once it is found.

DB-X10.why: s3.2 physics/instrument gate split: a registered timing-instrument gate miss voids the run. Which gates get registered is the author's choice.

DB-X11.why: s7.5 A2: the fitted foreground object must be identified on data fit for its role, which here would have been independent frequency data.

DB-X12.why: s7.5 A3 manipulation check against a threshold: did arsenate replacing phosphate deliver the named phosphate-free condition.

DB-X13.why: Fabrication is out of reach: s7.1.2 says ancestry is tamper-evident, not non-repudiable against fabrication; no check tests whether data are authentic.

DB-X14.why: s3.4 only says results SHOULD be machine-readable; no normative check validates data values for spreadsheet corruption.

DB-X15.why: s7.1/s4.3: a confirmatory class needs a registration that is an ancestor of the result; P3 refuses citing exploratory rows above their class.

DB-X16.why: s3.1 scope states the conditions of assertion; s10.4 says scope verification is a human task; D1 refuses invariance over an undeclared family.

DB-X17.why: s7.5 A3: did the manipulation move the named construct (depletion)? Whether e-crossing taps the construct is a construct-validity judgment.

DB-X18.why: No consistency check on reported statistics; P3 checks class, not values; CI comparison against committed results is L4, not a listed check.

DB-X19.why: s3.2 requires stating how the bar or power was sized. It refuses only a missing statement; an explicit 'not done' passes, so adequacy is judged.

DB-X20.why: s7.5 A3 instrument-invariance: is the unstirred-cell calorimetry still measuring under treatment? s3.2 instrument gate voids the run.

DB-X21.why: s3.4 committed results is not a listed check, and nothing verifies where primary data came from or that it exists.

DB-X22.why: Fabricated data: s7.1.2 disclaims protection against fabrication; no listed check detects it.

DB-X23.why: Fabricated or manipulated datasets: no listed check detects fabrication (s7.1.2).

DB-X24.why: Fabricated data found by distributional forensics; neither spec has a data-authenticity check (s7.1.2).

adjudication.DB-X03: Reader right. A4 as written had no multiplicity rule; the author credited it from the rubric, not the spec. A4 amended 2026-10-17.
adjudication.DB-X04: Reader right. A1 required one witness record; a 70% false-positive rate is a property of a distribution, which one record cannot show. A1 amended 2026-10-17 to require a witness distribution where grading is a statistical test.
adjudication.DB-X08: Both expressible; primary differs (author A1, reader P1). Either refuses it; counted as gate disagreement.
adjudication.DB-X20: Both expressible; primary differs (author s3.2, reader A3). Either refuses it; counted as gate disagreement.
